29Metals advances Capricorn Copper restart plans
news.summary: 29Metals has moved closer to restarting its Capricorn Copper mine in Queensland after securing preliminary environmental approval for a new long-term tailings storage facility. The Queensland Department of Environment, Tourism, Science and Innovation has granted preliminary approval for an amendment to the mine’s Environmental Authority.
